services.name: Newborn home visit
services.story: The same visit, paid by the family itself: nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the $179 bill when Felix texts DONE.

services_shape: visits with a set length, booked with a pediatrician or a nurse practitioner by name; well-child visits follow the office's own schedule of ages; same-day sick times open each morning; the shots due at a visit are chosen by the clinician there and never paid up front, and a flu shot can also be booked on its own as a nurse visit; a newborn's visit at home has a 2-hour arrival window
questions_before_times: the child's first name and age (the birth date only on the secure page)
a current patient or a new family
which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video visit: which state the child will be in
safety_stop: trouble breathing, won't wake up, blue lips, or a seizure
first_steps: Health history, changes since the last visit, the vaccine record and the consent
A written price estimate for self-pay families
A new family's records from the last doctor
Sam's OK for a new family
license: always: each pediatrician (MD or DO), nurse practitioner, physician assistant and nurse holds their own active license from the state where the child is during the visit; which roles need which license comes from the state's form (a switch)
staff_skills: pediatricians and nurse practitioners: well-child visits, sick visits, new families, video visits and newborn home visits; nurses: flu shots and shot-only visits on the clinician's order; the lactation consultant: breastfeeding help; only people cleared for home visits go to homes
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, symptoms, shots, results or the clinician's name (at a home visit the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
